在手机浏览器里导入歌单、调整播放设置与音源，改动即时同步到电视。: Import playlists, adjust playback and audio-source settings from your phone. Changes sync to the TV immediately.
粘贴 QQ 音乐 / 网易云 / 酷狗的公开歌单链接；也可以在下面粘多行「歌名: Paste a public playlist link from QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music or Kugou. You can also paste multiple lines of “Song - Artist”. Imported songs appear in the TV Library.

正数提前显示歌词，负数延后；歌词偏慢时可尝试 +200。: Positive values show lyrics earlier; negative values show them later. Try +200 if the lyrics lag behind.
电视扬声器可设为 0，蓝牙通常约 200 毫秒；应用后重置节拍缓冲。: Use 0 for TV speakers. Bluetooth is usually around 200 ms. Applying resets the beat buffer.
默认端口为 3000。使用代理模式时由电脑提供服务；留空仅使用本机模式，不检查电: The default port is 3000. A computer provides the proxy service. Leave this blank to use local mode without checking a computer proxy.
已开启，全部在本机处理: On: everything runs on this device
未配置代理，仅使用本机: No proxy configured. Using local mode only.
直接连接 Apple，提供浏览、资料库、搜索、封面、歌词和播放，无需电脑。部分歌: Connect directly to Apple for Browse, Library, search, artwork, lyrics, and playback without a computer. Some songs may have gaps between segments; computer proxy mode can resolve these gaps. Applies to the next song.
自动缓慢调整增益，使不同歌曲的响度更均衡。立即生效，可在应用日志的 VOL 条目: Adjust gain gradually to balance loudness between songs. Takes effect immediately. See VOL entries in the app log.
已开启，后台继续播放: On: continue playing in the background
已关闭，离开时暂停: Off: pause when leaving the app
下次启动应用时生效。: Applies the next time you start the app.
下一首歌曲生效，已经开始的渐变保持原有时长。较长渐变需要更早预加载下一首。: Applies to the next song. A crossfade already in progress keeps its duration. Longer crossfades need the next song to load earlier.
将应用版本、设备信息、最近崩溃、应用和网络日志汇总为文本文件。: Collect the app version, device details, recent crash, and app and network logs in a text file.

导入的脚本优先于随包版本，APK 升级不会覆盖；「恢复随包」会清空全部本地脚本。: Imported scripts take priority over bundled ones and survive APK upgrades. Restore Bundled removes all local scripts. The current song keeps playing; the change applies from the next song.
仅用于界面展示：读取账号、商店区域与资料库歌单名称；播放数据不会向 Apple: Display only: reads your account, storefront and library playlist names. Playback data is never requested from or sent to Apple Music — playback still uses the Luoxue source.
